sloka: आमन्त्रये ऽहं भगवन् कामं त्वामृषिसत्तम ।समीपं प्रस्थितं भ्रातुर्मैत्रेणेक्षस्व चक्षुषा ॥ २.९२.७॥
transliteration: āmantraye 'haṁ bhagavan kāmaṁ tvāmṛṣisattama ।samīpaṁ prasthitaṁ bhrāturmaitreṇekṣasva cakṣuṣā ॥ 2.92.7॥

translations.english: O venerable one O excellent of the ascetics I seek your leave. As I am proceeding to see my brother, bless me with a kindly look.
